body.name: Finite conditional Gaussian face--knot experiment
body.construction: Condition on \(\mathscr S_\eta=\sigma(\eta)\), where \(\eta\) includes \(w^0\) and the limiting pre-score covariance \(\Omega\).  For \(\theta\in\Gamma_\eta\), draw \((g,Z)\sim N(0,\Sigma_\eta)\), whose pre block is \(g\sim N_L(0,\Omega)\), whose post block has the within-cell bridge covariances, and whose pre and post blocks are independent.  Form \(\mathsf X_{\eta,\theta}\) from the shifted pre coordinate and shared-noise knot-group coordinates, and denote its conditional law by \(\Pr_{\eta,\theta}\).  The statistic \(\eta\) contains the limiting weight, every within-cell offset difference, and all limiting design and covariance objects; \(\theta\) contains only unresolved cross-cell group translations and simplex-face offsets.
